Look for this asymmetry before assuming a port would have been easier.
  2. The parts that did NOT come across are exactly the ones with machinery behind them: AJCR's base H1 vanishing comes from the FLV-class machine (finite dominant pi : Y -> P1 + fiber divisor), its peel from peel_effective on divisorSheaf. Those became named hypotheses in AJC. So the vanishing lane is assembled but conditional; the degree and drop lanes are unconditional.

ALSO DURABLE: extension-uniformity of a vanishing bound is not merely unproved in AJC, it is not currently STATABLE. All adelic invariants are pinned on a chosen 2-affine cover (deliberately, to avoid the HasCechToHModuleIso gate), and RiemannRoch/CurveBaseChange.lean gives C_kappa as an AJC curve but does NOT transport the cover data.
